tooltip.essentialcraft5.magical_cultivat.en: Grows the seed or sapling you put in on MRU and water; the sample is never used up
tooltip.essentialcraft5.magical_cultivat.zh: 放一叠种子或树苗进去，用 MRU 和水在机器里种，样本不会被用掉

gui.essentialcraft5.magical_cultivator.s.en: Each round grows every plant once; the harvest goes to the slots on the right
gui.essentialcraft5.magical_cultivator.s.zh: 每轮每株各收一次，收成放进右边的格子

gui.essentialcraft5.magical_cultivator.s.en: Put seeds, a sapling or another plant in the leftmost of the three bottom-left slots
gui.essentialcraft5.magical_cultivator.s.zh: 在左下三格最左边那格放种子、树苗或别的作物

gui.essentialcraft5.magical_cultivator.s.en: This item has no cultivator recipe, and it isn't a crop that grows on plain farmland
gui.essentialcraft5.magical_cultivator.s.zh: 这样东西没有栽培配方，也不是种得在普通耕地上的作物

gui.essentialcraft5.magical_cultivator.s.en: Put a Water Bucket in the middle slot, or place a water source next to the machine or under it
gui.essentialcraft5.magical_cultivator.s.zh: 在中间那格放一桶水，或者让机器侧面、正下方挨着一格水源

gui.essentialcraft5.magical_cultivator.s.en: MRU is paid a little every tick; growing pauses until more arrives
gui.essentialcraft5.magical_cultivator.s.zh: MRU 每刻扣一点，不够时停在原处，MRU 到了接着长

gui.essentialcraft5.magical_cultivator.s.en: The harvest won't fit; take some items out of the slots on the right
gui.essentialcraft5.magical_cultivator.s.zh: 这一轮的收成放不下，把右边格子里的东西拿走一些

gui.essentialcraft5.magical_cultivator.s.en: Remove the redstone signal and it carries on where it stopped
gui.essentialcraft5.magical_cultivator.s.zh: 去掉红石信号，它从停下的地方接着长

gui.essentialcraft5.magical_cultivator.s.en: Magical cultivators don't work in this world
gui.essentialcraft5.magical_cultivator.s.zh: 这个世界里魔力栽培器不工作

gui.essentialcraft5.magical_cultivator.r.en: %1$s a round · %2$s MRU per plant · up to %3$s plants
gui.essentialcraft5.magical_cultivator.r.zh: 每轮 %1$s · 每株 %2$s MRU · 最多 %3$s 株

gui.essentialcraft5.magical_cultivator.r.en: Bone Meal speeds up a round

jei.essentialcraft5.cultivator.generic.w.en: A crop from another mod with no recipe grows from its own mature drops, as long as it grows on plain farmland
jei.essentialcraft5.cultivator.generic.w.zh: 没有配方的别的模组作物，只要种得在普通耕地上，就按它自己长熟后的掉落来种

jei.essentialcraft5.cultivator.generic.y.en: One of the drops goes back as the next seed; at most %s items per plant
jei.essentialcraft5.cultivator.generic.y.zh: 每株的掉落里扣掉 1 个当种子，最多出 %s 件

jei.essentialcraft5.cultivator.generic.n.en: None of the crops in this game qualify right now
jei.essentialcraft5.cultivator.generic.n.zh: 这局游戏里目前没有这样的作物
